sections.t: The Terror of the Main Road
p: Near Abercrombie's shack, northeast of Raven Hill Cemetery, Stitches sets out east along the road toward Darkshire. Unholy sorcery and harvested corpses made the undead abomination, whose immense strength and malice overwhelm the Night Watch checkpoints. He tears through the defense camp across from Vul'Gol Ogre Mound and the outpost outside the Rotting Orchard, slaughtering travelers and town defenders along the way.
